protocol.training: LOSO: each fold trains on 56 subjects; LR C=0.001; fit_mlp defaults (30 epoch), seeds [0,1,2] mean
protocol.scaling: std_lr/std_mlp are pooled outputs over training subjects only
protocol.components: save LR_scaled, MLP_scaled and raw for each fixed wLR
